questions.question: Born on this day in 1470, which English monarch reigned briefly in 1483 before being deposed by his uncle Richard III without ever having a coronation?
questions.explanation: Edward V succeeded his father in April 1483 but was removed from power by the Duke of Gloucester two months later.
questions.context:
On this day in 1470: Edward V, King of England (died 1483)
Edward V (King of England in 1483): Edward V was King of England from 9 April to 25 June 1483. He succeeded his father, Edward IV, upon the latter's death. Edward V was never crowned, and his brief reign was dominated by the influence of his uncle and Lord Protector, the Duke of Gloucester, who deposed him to reign as King Richard III.

questions.question: In the 2026 romantic fantasy comedy-drama film 'Wicker', which actress stars opposite Alexander Skarsgård?
questions.explanation: Olivia Colman heads the cast of Wicker, an adaptation of Ursula Wills's story 'The Wicker Husband'.
questions.context: Wicker (film) (2026 film by Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Wilson): Wicker is a 2026 romantic fantasy comedy-drama film written and directed by Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Wilson, based on the short story "The Wicker Husband" by Ursula Wills. The film stars Olivia Colman, Alexander Skarsgård, Elizabeth Debicki, Marli Siu, Nabhaan Rizwan, Richard E. Grant, and Peter Dinklage.

questions.question: Which jawless fish is known for having a toothed, funnel-like sucking mouth?
questions.explanation: Adult lampreys belong to the order Petromyzontiformes and feature a distinctive toothed sucking mouth.
questions.context: Lamprey (Class of jawless fish): Lampreys are a group of jawless fish composing the order Petromyzontiformes, sole order in the class Petromyzontida. The adult lamprey is characterized by a toothed, funnel-like, sucking mouth. The common name "lamprey" is probably derived from Latin lampetra, which may mean "stone licker", though the etymology is uncertain. "Lamprey" is sometimes seen for the plural form.

questions.question: The American crime drama television series 'Nocturne' is adapted from 'The Sandman', a novel written under what pseudonym by Alexander and Alexandra Ahndoril?
questions.explanation: The married writing duo Alexander and Alexandra Coelho Ahndoril use the pen name Lars Kepler.
questions.context: Nocturne (TV series) (2026 American crime drama series): Nocturne is an American crime drama television series created by Rowan Joffé and developed by John Hlavin. The series is based on the Joona Linna novel The Sandman by the husband-and-wife team Alexander Ahndoril and Alexandra Coelho Ahndoril, who use the pen name Lars Kepler.

questions.question: Which English actor made his television debut playing a young version of Ned Stark in 'Game of Thrones' in 2016?
questions.explanation: Sebastian Croft debuted on TV portraying the young Ned Stark in Game of Thrones before appearing in Heartstopper.
questions.context: Sebastian Croft (English actor (born 2001)): Sebastian Theodore Kemble "Bash" Croft is an English actor and musician. He began his career as a child actor on stage before making his television debut as Young Ned Stark in Game of Thrones (2016). He earned a BAFTA Children's Award nomination for his role in Horrible Histories: The Movie – Rotten Romans (2019). He has since starred in the Netflix series Heartstopper (2022–2024) and took part in the second series of The Celebrity Traitors.
